title: P0.36: Security-verification preflight must be a causal terminal state
description: After P0.35 live verification, the external ChatGPT flow advanced past observation permission and reached a browser security verification block. The runtime still emitted terminal_state=failed_with_actionable_reason instead of blocked_by_security_verification, weakening OSES, follow-up continuity, and user guidance.
resume_hint: Implemented locally in ControlCenterViewModel._blocked_external_consultation_result(): preflight diagnostic_category/external_state_flags/reason containing browser_security_verification now returns terminal_state=blocked_by_security_verification, block_type=browser_security_verification, and the structured security handoff message.
next_action: Restart IABV so P0.36 is loaded, reproduce the ChatGPT query after observation permission is granted, and verify dispatch_terminal.terminal_state is blocked_by_security_verification unless the user has already resolved the ChatGPT challenge and a response is captured.

live_evidence.observed_after_p035: permission grant no longer repeated; next block reason was ChatGPT web asistido quedo bloqueado por una verificacion de seguridad del sitio

tests.regression: P0.22/P0.1/P0 antifreeze + world model permission override

reason: A metacognitive runtime cannot learn from generic failures. Browser security verification is a distinct causal state and must stay distinct from permission, resource pressure, and generic failure.
